name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: A CLI tool that reads why your CI pipeline broke, traces the actual cause, and proposes a fix for a human to review — instead of you digging through logs at midnight.
buyer: A platform engineer at a mid-size company tired of being paged for flaky or broken CI pipelines.
business_use_cases: A platform team self-hosts it to cut the time engineers spend triaging red CI builds across dozens of repos.
A DevOps consultancy offers 'CI reliability audits' using this tool to quickly show clients where their pipelines are fragile.
An engineering org uses it to draft fix PRs automatically for common flaky-test patterns, freeing senior engineers for harder work.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted/managed version with support for teams that don't want to self-host.
Sell CI-health audit reports as a one-off consulting product to engineering leadership.

steal_this: Run it against your own (or a friend's) flaky CI pipeline this weekend, document the fixes it finds, and use that case study to pitch a paid pilot to a small startup.
